_doc: Per-keyword spec for the synthetic wake-word eval corpus. One file per keyword in this directory; shared voices + condition profiles live in _voices.json. `python -m scripts.gen_wake_corpus --keyword mission_control` reads this. The audio is provisioned per install (TTS is not bit-reproducible); the manifest records checksums. See docs/wake-word-provider-bakeoff.md.
